tasks.title: Check-ups when the calendar says no

steps.request: Patients book check-ups in our app; the Slotbook SDK, the package slotbook-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in SLOTBOOK_API_KEY for the free slots; use the same client. When someone else took the slot in the meantime, the patient must not get an error: the booking answers status 'taken' and suggestion, the start time of the first free slot left that day (or null when the day is full).

On Monday mornings Slotbook is overloaded and asks us to wait before trying again. Then the booking answers status 'try_later' and retryIn, the number of seconds Slotbook asks us to wait (30 when it does not say).
A patient can hold only one check-up booked through the app. A second booking by the same patient answers the error 'You already have a check-up booked.' and nothing is reserved.
